site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering provider and promotes software development services, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency described in the approved sources. Replace the old positioning and service catalog, and verify or remove the unsupported claims identified below.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI positioning
llm_problems.issue: The schema describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and an agency hiring broadly defined talent, rather than using the approved company description.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the positioning and company description with the approved description and current staffing and recruiting focus.

llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner
